text_block_list.text: —Summer training camp is finally coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai! Can I sit next to you on the bus ride home?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? N-N-No way, no can do!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Why not? Who cares, it's fineeee!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen! I'm just so grateful to you, Senpai,
for cheering me up the other evening!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing your true feelings gave me courage, Senpai.
I really want to talk more about what happened back then!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I don't recall cheering you up at all, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You said all those nice things to me!
You even wiped away my tears...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaah! Stoooop itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan isn't
some goody two-shoeees!"

"Having opened up about my passionate feelings so honestly that day,
I suppose I feel a bit awkward... or rather, 'embarrassed'...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I found a kind of 'strength' in you, Senpai,
that I don't have in myself."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It made me want that too—
it made me want to get stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: U-Uh... huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, if you don't get it, that's fine.
Senpai's just that kind of person, and that's why she's strong.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger too.
Just like how Windy-senpai aims for her "ambition"...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna make my dream of
becoming a hero come true too...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Hmph... Do whatever you want.

Shinko Windy had been horsing around with Biko Pegasus, but...
After a bit, she came over and sat down beside me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That Biko was relentless.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is busy watching race footage from the past! I don't have time to look after her.
choice_data_list: You're fired up for the race, huh!
You're fired up for the race, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "It's totally normal~! I just do it because it pisses me off when I can't win!"

No matter how contrarian she acts,
her effort and her feelings are genuine.
choice_data_list: (Someday, the world's opinion will absolutely change)

text_block_list.text:
Let's take it easy without rushing.
After all, our next objective stays as planned...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it was the 'Tokai Stakes', right?
I've been looking forward to this trip, nod-nod.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's stick to the plan then.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...!
I'll make the terror of Windy-chan echo even in distant lands~!

Our next target is the Tokai Stakes!
Public perception doesn't change overnight.
Let's keep steadily racking up victories.
